f0.scope: Identity/count/hash agreement of original receipts; complete fixed original denominator. Original F0 binary not independently bound by this reader. No new Host/native run.

costs.scope: All recorded per-call stamps, with completion/success/unknown counts preserved. Calling-thread CPU only. Host phase is nested within importer and is not additive.
